run_main_download_sst: run the script to download SST sentiment dataset files from PrincetonML SIF repository
run_main_convert_to_jsonl: run the script to convert tab-separated SST sentiment files into JSONL format
run_main_spacy_tokenize: run the script to tokenize and normalize SST sentiment text using spaCy English NLP model
review_main_data_pipeline: review the main function that downloads processes and converts SST dataset files to JSONL
refactor_main_add_cli_args: refactor the main function to accept configurable dataset paths and output formats via CLI arguments
